command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp

echo "== the canonical Lennard-Jones melt: analytic lj/cut, needs no data file =="
# This is the content of LAMMPS' own bench/in.lj, embedded because the conda package
# ships only the binaries and the python module, not the bench/ tree. lj/cut is an
# analytic potential, so there is genuinely nothing to stage.
cat > in.melt <<'EOF'
units lj
atom_style atomic
lattice fcc 0.8442
region box block 0 4 0 4 0 4
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 1.0
velocity all create 3.0 87287 loop geom
pair_style lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff 1 1 1.0 1.0 2.5
neighbor 0.3 bin
neigh_modify every 20 delay 0 check no
fix 1 all nve
thermo 25
run 50
EOF

echo "== run serial, then over 2 MPI ranks =="
lmp_mpi -in in.melt -log s.log > s.out 2>&1
mpiexec -n 2 --oversubscribe lmp_mpi -in in.melt -log p.log > p.out 2>&1

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)

def parse(logfile):
    txt=open(logfile).read()
    # thermo block: header line starting with "Step", then numeric rows, TotEng is col 5
    rows=[]
    inblk=False
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if re.match(r"^\s*Step\s", ln): inblk=True; continue
        if inblk:
            p=ln.split()
            if len(p)>=6 and re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", p[0]):
                rows.append((int(p[0]), float(p[4])))
            elif rows:
                inblk=False
    return txt, rows

stxt, srows = parse("s.log")
ptxt, prows = parse("p.log")
s_final = dict(srows).get(50)
p_final = dict(prows).get(50)
s_init  = dict(srows).get(0)

# atoms created -- exact
na=re.search(r"Created (\d+) atoms", stxt)
na_val=int(na.group(1)) if na else -1
check("atoms_created", na_val==256, f"{na_val}  want exactly 256 (4x4x4 fcc, 4-atom basis)")

# MPI actually ran on 2 ranks -- the whole reason for the openmpi build
mt=re.search(r"with (\d+) MPI task", ptxt)
mt_val=int(mt.group(1)) if mt else -1
check("mpi_ranks", mt_val==2, f"{mt_val}  want exactly 2 MPI tasks")

# total energy physical, and reproduces the pinned-image value
check("final_toteng", s_final is not None and -4.0 < s_final < -1.0,
      f"{s_final}  want -4..-1 reduced (observed -2.2990327)")

# INTERNAL CROSS-VALIDATION: serial vs 2-rank must agree. Domain decomposition changes
# the force-summation order, so this is a floating-point-reordering tolerance, not a
# physics one -- two independent computations of the same trajectory.
agree = (s_final is not None and p_final is not None and abs(s_final-p_final) < 1e-2)
check("serial_eq_2rank", agree,
      f"|{s_final} - {p_final}| < 1e-2  (independent decompositions must agree)")

# NVE conservation: total energy drift over the run, a physical conservation law
drift = abs(s_final - s_init) if (s_final is not None and s_init is not None) else 99
check("nve_conserved", drift < 0.05, f"drift {drift:.4f} < 0.05 over 50 steps (NVE)")

# completion sentinel
check("lammps_completed", "Total wall time" in stxt and "Total wall time" in ptxt,
      f"{'yes' if 'Total wall time' in stxt and 'Total wall time' in ptxt else 'NO'}  want 'Total wall time' in both logs")

if fail:
    print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
test -s s.log; test -s p.log
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
